title: Trusted colleagues report firsthand encounters with beings

tellings.quote: sounds, the most trusted people in my circle that I have worked with and do work with um have those speak to having those firsthand experiences with.

plain: A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he once carried a UFO with his helicopter, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that the most trusted people he has worked with speak of having firsthand encounters with beings. He gives no names, places or dates. If true, it would mean people inside his working circle have met non-human beings directly.
